title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
author: Silas Okonkwo
blurb: Wren Dunmore, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
